quick: Dr Shikha Goel is the director of Goel Dental and an endodontist: MDS in Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics (2010) from Bapuji Dental College, Davangere, and a former Research Officer at AIIMS, New Delhi. She leads root canal, microscope and cosmetic treatment at the clinic.
body:
[gd_img name="dr-shikha-reception" alt="Dr Shikha Goel, endodontist and director of Goel Dental, at the clinic reception" cap="Dr Shikha Goel at the Malviya Nagar clinic"]

Qualifications

  • BDS, 2006 [gd_confirm]Old page names two different BDS colleges[/gd_confirm]
  • MDS, Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics, 2010, Bapuji Dental College, Davangere, Karnataka
  • Research Officer, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, for six months

[gd_confirm]Add Dental Council registration number[/gd_confirm]

What she treats

  • Root canals, including microscopic and single-sitting treatment and re-treatment
  • Front-teeth cosmetic problems: gaps, discolouration, chips, fractures, fluorosis patches and uneven lengths
  • Metal-free crowns, ceramic veneers and implants

Children

She set up a separate children's room at the clinic, designed so children do not see the dental equipment. See children's dentistry.

Outside the clinic

She works with NGOs and charitable trusts on dental care for people who cannot easily get it.

Questions

What is an endodontist?

A dentist with a postgraduate degree (MDS) in treating the inside of the tooth: root canals, re-treatments and saving damaged teeth.

How do I book Dr Shikha Goel?

Book online or call the clinic and ask for Dr Shikha Goel. Root canal and cosmetic consultations are with her.
